description: The stripping of pixel-swarm: a game works with it (sprites, 2D physics, audio, uGUI and TextMeshPro with static SDF fonts)

overrides.why: the uGUI fork is made from the package of Unity 7000: Unity 6 takes its built-in uGUI (without the patches of the fork) and the TextMeshPro shaders of its essential resources
the uGUI fork is the built-in package of 7000.0.0a10; 7000.0.0a20 ships uGUI 7.0.0 with new runtime code (TextMesh Pro, layout, event system): its built-in package with the patches of the fork
